markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class prediction set [F1], model agreement, and low invasion scores support routine review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, Normal 2%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Near-certain Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% error rate (90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 76th percentile OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality; not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign, 1/5 Normal (BACH_0033, 89% similarity) [F5] | Reference neighbors mostly Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.80, contribution -1.20) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.48, contribution -0.90) [F3]; failed 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.20, contribution -0.38) favors benign stroma [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · High text score (1.17, contribution -0.29), caption-inconsistent · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 0, 3, 11) · context · 0% immune cells (9th percentile) [F7]; 35% labeled neoplastic (72nd percentile) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability versus random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unfaithful (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009–0.006); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Contrast case BACH_0033 is Normal (89% similarity), differing in duct-confined atypia (regions 0, 7) and unreliable necrosis (region 0).
- Focal neoplasia in region 3 (50 neoplastic-labeled nuclei) or region 8 (highest tile risk, 0.001) is missed.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Confirm benign stroma and absent invasion; ignore unreliable normal-lobule and mitosis scores.
2. **Regions 0, 7**: Check ducts for confined atypia (weak, 12/20) vs Normal; region 0 necrosis score is unreliable.
3. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Verify benign tubules and inspect region 3 (50 neoplastic, 38 epithelial nuclei segmented).
